name: Bar Chart
pick_when: Values compared across 3–10 categories: states, companies, years, products; rankings with numbers; a threshold to beat.

duration.note: Length comes from the voice beat (clock.durationInFrames), not from props.

rules: Stay within every limit below; longer text is shortened at a word boundary, too-short or missing required fields are errors.
Numbers are raw values (no commas, units or currency symbols) — the template formats and animates them.
Only real, sourced facts, quotes and figures. Label invented example numbers as illustrative.
Icons are Lucide names from the repository icon map; unknown names render as a circle.
